breakdown.description: Manning equation is an open-channel empirical relation and is not applicable to laminar internal microchannel flow.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the Manning equation is inappropriate for laminar internal microchannel flow. It explicitly stated, 'Do not use the Manning equation; it is invalid for closed-conduit pressure-driven laminar flow.' It then replaced this incorrect method with the appropriate physical relations (Darcy-Weisbach and Hagen-Poiseuille), which directly aligns with the correction made in the ground truth.
